senses.definition: n.pr.mont. Σανειρ: Amorite name of Ḥermon Dt 3:9, whence came cypress-trees Ez 27:5, prob. northern peak(s) of Ḥ. 1 Ch 5:23 Ct 4:8 (where + חֶרְמוֹן); so Arabic سنير, Abulfed. Par. 68, Syriac ܣܢܺܝܪ, Ecclus 24:13 al., Assyrian Saniru COT Dt 3:9 DlPa 104. Vid. also Dr Dt 3:9 BuhlGeogr. 110 f. and reff. [van d. H. erron. שׁ׳ Dt Ct].
